officialProductListing.evidence: Retail listing identifies the 26/27 DR as directional with a broad nose, 50 mm setback, nose rocker, and three nose/tail outline variants. These are product-positioning/spec claims rather than test results.
officialProductListing.limitations: Retail listing, not manufacturer technical documentation; no directly confirmed 26/27 test sample found.

officialDemoList2025-26.location: White World Oze Iwakura, Gunma, Japan
officialDemoList2025-26.evidence: Manufacturer-hosted 25/26 demo inventory included multiple DR sizes.
officialDemoList2025-26.limitations: Inventory list only; does not document a rider test or actual ride conditions. It is one season earlier than the seed's 26/27 model.

fullSeasonRiderReview2024-25.testedBoard: BC Stream DR 161, purchased before and ridden throughout the 2024-25 season
fullSeasonRiderReview2024-25.duration: Full season; exact ride-day count not disclosed.
fullSeasonRiderReview2024-25.reportedConditions: Reviewer says the season had abundant powder and reports resort powder use; no snow depths or per-day conditions given.
observations: Reviewer reports strong carving feel, but says the board requires the rider to bend it with technique; around 9 m sidecut makes continuous carving on steeper/narrower runs speed-limited.
Reports substantial resort powder capability and responsive, enjoyable turns; backcountry was not tested.
Reports enjoyable terrain riding and straight jumps; spins are harder than on twin/directional-twin boards due to the long nose.
Does not recommend it as a pure park or buttering board; did not test jibbing.
Reviewer says response initially felt peaky but that sensation later faded (adaptation or edge rounding was uncertain).
fullSeasonRiderReview2024-25.limitations: This is a single rider's full-season subjective report of the previous 24/25 version, not the seed's 26/27 version. Exact rider profile, test days, snow depth, model variant and binding setup are not disclosed in the opened review. Do not convert its language to numeric site scores.

scoringEvidence.decision: Retain all six 26/27 scores as low-confidence estimates. The previous-season full-season review broadly supports a versatile carving/powder board, with limits for steep/narrow carving, spins, jibbing and buttering; the official 25/26 demo inventory does not report ride outcomes. Since the seed is 26/27 and has several outline variants, the 24/25 single-rider account is directional historical evidence only. Value remains particularly uncertain because the seed price is converted from Japan MSRP, not China retail.
scoringEvidence.confidence: Low for all dimensions. Historical DR review is meaningful directional evidence but does not test the 26/27 variant; no external rating is numerically mapped.

unresolved: Seed does not specify which of the three 26/27 DR outline variants its scores represent.
No China-market price; no verified representative-size geometry/weight or image reuse authorization in this evidence batch.
